name: JSON Validator
summary: Validate JSON syntax locally and get clear error locations.
description: Check whether your payload is valid JSON before you ship it. Validation runs in your browser and highlights parse errors with line and column when available.

faqs.question: Will validation happen on a server?
faqs.answer: No. Validation uses your browser’s JSON parser only.

faqs.question: Does it check JSON Schema?
faqs.answer: Not yet. This tool validates syntax. Schema validation can come later as a separate tool.

faqs.question: Can I validate large JSON files?
faqs.answer: Browser memory limits apply. Typical API payloads work well.

faqs.question: Is an account required?
faqs.answer: No. Forge has no authentication for the MVP.
